# TWIST-J

> TWIST-J derives physics from one axiom: J = 1 + j², where j is the twist unit, a primitive fifth root of unity. Multiplication by J is a 4x4 integer matrix over {-1, 0, 1}. Galois structure yields an exact 3+1+0 decomposition. Zero free dimensionless parameters; one SI calibration anchor (the electron mass). The algebra is proved. The physics is falsifiable.

Author: A. M. Thorn. ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-5463-278X
Hub: https://twistj.com

Reading: Time is a counter. Space is a commutator. J is the verb; φ and π are projections of J. If it cannot be calculated in integers, it is not physics. Plenum, not vacuum.

Status discipline: every claim carries a label, T / D / C / H / O / F / LOCK, ordered T-LOCK > T > D > C > H > O > F. No summary is stronger than its committed source. Falsification is registered as first-class progress. Exact rational and algebraic arithmetic throughout: ratios, not decimals, unless a decimal is justified by measurement.

## Papers

Full registry of works: https://orcid.org/0009-0008-5463-278X

- [Twist Numbers and Four-Dimensional Integer J Algebra](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19056597): the foundation
- [Twisted Units, Celestial Symmetries and Entropic Motion](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18311965): adelic computations, dilogarithmic identities, hyperbolic dynamics in Q(ζ5)
- [The Hyperbolic Automorphism J: A Golden Ratio Unit in Z[ζ5]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18523754)
- [Time from a single algebraic datum: the Page-Wootters mechanism over Z[j]](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19313537)
- [Dense cyclotomic subgroups of the Lorentz group and the Collins-Perez-Sudarsky obstruction](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20029795)
- [The Broken Symmetry is an Integer Fraction: 3:5:5 trace partition and the 3/13 electroweak mixing skeleton](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20141133)
